help_install_step1: Searches the service in the catalogo (usa the buscador or filtra by categoria).
help_install_step2: Haz clic in Detalles for view requisitos of RAM, disco, port and subdomain.
help_install_step3: Verifica that your server has enough RAM and disco.
help_install_step4: Haz clic in Install. The system genera the docker-compose.yml and them instrucciones.
help_install_step5: The service appears as Corriendo or Detenido. Puedes iniciarlo, detenerlo or desinstalarlo when quieras.
help_download_docker_desc: If prefieres install the service manually in other server, haz clic in Download. Is downloaded a file with the docker-compose.yml and a README.md with instrucciones.
help_subdomain_desc: Each service has a subdomain sugerido. If tienes OpenWrt configurado, the subdomain itself registra automaticamente in it intranet.
help_add_service_desc: The catalogo this definido in the codigo of the backend (internal/api/services_catalog.go). For add a service new:
help_email_components_desc: The correo electronico has three componentes that itself instalan by separado:
help_email_server_desc: (Mailu or Mailcow): itself instala in the node. Receives and envia correos. Creates cuentas for each member.
help_email_webmail_desc: (SnappyMail): interfaz web for read correo from the navegador without install nothing.
help_email_chat_desc: (Delta Chat): app that itself instala in the celular/PC of each member. Itself ve as WhatsApp but usa the server of correo of the node.
help_mail_rules_desc: From the panel of administracion of Mailu or Mailcow puedes configure:
help_mail_rules_note: These rules itself configuran from the panel web of the server of correo, no from the system of gobernanza.
help_catalog_desc: Is a list of mas of 20 services autohospedados that puedes install in the server of your node. Each service reemplaza a plataforma comercial (YouTube, WhatsApp, Netflix, etc.) but without anuncios, without vigilancia and without empresas intermediarias. Them data itself quedan in your server.
help_add_step2: Adds a entry to the slice
help_add_step4: Reinicia the node. The service new appears automaticamente in the catalogo.
help_add_note: Nota: the instalador with a clic requires that the service tenga a image Docker publica. If the service no usa Docker, only can be install manually with "Download" and siguiendo them instrucciones.
help_permission_desc: For install, uninstall, start or stop services necesitas the permission
help_permission_desc2: It Assembly decides who has this permission through them roles and departments of the system.
help_federation_desc: Them services that soportan ActivityPub (PeerTube, Mastodon, Pixelfed, Friendica, Lemmy, BookWyrm, Funkwhale) can federarse with other aldeas. This significa that the content publicado in a aldea is visible from them other aldeas federadas. For federate services, each aldea must install the same service and configure it federacion between they.
help_mail_choice: If your node has poca RAM, instala Mailu. If tienes other server with mas RAM, instala Mailcow alli. Ambos federan with cualquier server of correo of the world.
help_email_clients_desc: Despues of install Mailu or Mailcow, them members configuran its clients of correo asi:
help_email_pass: Contrasena: it that the admin him asigno
help_email_clients_recommended: Clients recomendados: Thunderbird (PC), K-9 Mail (Android), Mail (iOS). It mayoria itself autoconfiguran via Autoconfig/Autodiscover: only colocas the correo and it contrasena, and the client finds the server automaticamente.
help_delta_chat_desc: Delta Chat is a Client (app) that itself instala in the celular or PC of each member, no in the server. For usarlo:
help_delta_step1: Instala Mailu or Mailcow in the node.
help_delta_step2: The admin creates a account of correo for each member.
help_delta_step3: Each member instala Delta Chat in its celular (Google Play, App Store, F-Droid).
help_delta_step4: In Delta Chat, coloca its correo@{nodeDomain} and contrasena.
help_delta_step5: Delta Chat itself conecta automaticamente to the server IMAP/SMTP of the node.
help_delta_step6: For chatear with someone of other aldea: adds its correo@other-aldea.com.
help_delta_note: There is no that configure servers manually in Delta Chat. Only correo and contrasena. The chat itself ve igual that WhatsApp: messages, fotos, files, grupos, llamadas.
